decisions.decision: The board decided to speak with the Town Manager about the COA closing policy for snow days, with the Communication Task Group to contact the Town Manager that day.
decisions.quote: after due diligent discussion the board decided to speak with the town manager about the coa closing policy.

decisions.decision: COA board members all volunteered to help out in shelter situations.
decisions.quote: coa board members all volunteered to help out in shelter situations.

decisions.decision: Ms. Dwyer will work on creating the Eagle House Facebook page with assistance from the Director.
decisions.quote: ms. dwyer will work on creating the facebook page with assistance from the director.

decisions.decision: Filming or photos at the senior center in the future will be preceded by a general announcement to clients.
decisions.quote: it was determined that in the future if there were to be any filming/photos taken at the senior center a general announcement would be made to the clients about it.

decisions.decision: Ms. Nowd will contact Representative Benson's office to request an appointment to discuss elder issues.
decisions.quote: ms. nowd will contact representative benson's office in regards to making an appointment to discuss elder issues with her at her convenience.

decisions.decision: The Communication Task Group will contact the Town Manager later that day regarding the snow closure policy.
decisions.quote: the communication task group will contact the town manager later today regarding the snow closure policy.

decisions.decision: Decaffeinated coffee was determined to be already available and paid for by the Supporters; a new senior van was determined not to qualify as an appropriate request to the Supporters.
decisions.quote: new senior van (determined that this request does not qualify as an appropriate request for the supporters)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY16 budget has been sent to the Town Manager, is unbalanced, and funding sources are still under review for this year and the next; the Director will present it to the board on completion.
budget_items.quote: the fy16 budget has been sent to the town manager, is unbalanced and funding sources are still being reviewed

budget_items.topic: Senior Citizen Property Tax Work Off Program
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The program is setback because the IRS wants to tax participants, making them Town employees who must file W2 forms, which may affect participants receiving food stamps and fuel assistance; slot and applicant counts were reported.
figures_as_printed: 5 of which have started the program
budget_items.quote: currently there are 17 slots with 9 applicant s, 5 of which have started the program

budget_items.topic: Wish list for Supporters of Eagle House Inc.
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board members discussed items to request from the Supporters for purchase; decaffeinated coffee is already paid for by the Supporters and a new senior van does not qualify.
budget_items.quote: new senior van (determined that this request does not qualify as an appropriate request for the supporters)
